english.title: Speeding - exceed 20 mph on restricted road in Wales - automatic camera device

english.notes: From 17th September 2023 and due to Article 2 of SI 2022/800 Restricted Roads (20 mph Speed Limit) (Wales) Order 2022 the rate of speed fixed by section 81(1) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 is reduced to 20 miles per hour for Wales only. For the offence applying in Wales and to manned equipment from the 17th September 2023, see H101066.
